_note: How skills map to agents. Discoverer, Scorer, Writer, Verifier and Filler are project agents in .claude/agents/ with their own context; the main session (HQ) keeps everything that talks to the candidate. The monitor draws this graph.

agents.name: Main session
agents.role: Talks to you, runs the day, asks every form question, hands over, records outcomes

agents.name: Discoverer
agents.role: Finds postings, pre-filters, batches the shortlist

agents.name: Scorer
agents.role: Scores one batch; several run in parallel

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Tailors resume and letters from the fact bank

agents.name: Filler
agents.role: Fills one approved form in its own tab; several run in parallel; stops before Submit

context_target_pct.main: may run higher when the candidate talks with HQ a lot
context_target_pct._note: keep helper agents' context low so they do not hallucinate from crowded context
